depiction.primary_object: square picture frame containing two mountain peaks
modifiers: upward arrow in top right corner

ambiguity: Could be confused with a generic file upload icon or an external link icon if the mountain peaks inside the frame are hard to make out at very small sizes.

modifier_semantics.modifier: upward arrow in top right corner
modifier_semantics.meaning: upload, export, publish, or send upwards

reasoning: The icon clearly combines the standard landscape picture glyph with an upward arrow in the corner, universally understood as uploading or exporting an image. It fits many real-world tasks across personal life (sharing family photos, uploading ID pictures, insurance claims) and work (exporting assets, updating headshots). It is distinct from generic file upload icons because of the mountain peaks inside the frame.
